name: Authentication Composite State Catalog
summary: Organizes authentication dimensions into logical regions and records explicit cross-dimension dependencies without flattening the composite state into a giant enumeration.

regions.name: Identity Lifecycle
regions.summary: Tracks anonymous, pending, and durable identity resolution.

regions.name: Value Ownership
regions.summary: Tracks whether guest-created value exists and whether it has been claimed.

regions.name: Credential and Proof
regions.summary: Tracks identity proof, verified email ownership, and profile completion.

regions.name: Account Lifecycle
regions.summary: Tracks whether the durable account may participate normally.

regions.name: Workspace Access
regions.summary: Tracks home workspace, current workspace, memberships, and invitations.

regions.name: Assurance and Recovery
regions.summary: Tracks MFA assurance and account recovery restrictions.

regions.name: Derived Projections
regions.summary: Contains non-canonical session and presentation projections derived from or applied to canonical state.

dependencies.summary: An active PendingIdentity requires exactly one non-none flow bucket.
A resolved durable identity must receive exactly one home workspace during registration completion.
The current workspace must be one the durable identity may access.
Invitation acceptance requires an explicitly selected durable identity.
Claimed guest value must be securely bound to the originating guest identity.
Disabled or locked account state constrains normal authenticated session capability.
MFA assurance contributes to the capabilities projected into a session.
Recovery state may restrict session capabilities until sufficient proof is restored.
Presentation context selects an adapter but may not redefine behavioral authorization.
